<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tracks(fr):
    t1={}; t2={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==4 and n['color'] not in ('G',):
            r,c=n['boundary'][0]
            if r==26: t1[c]=n['color']
            if r==35: t2[c]=n['color']
    cols=[17,20,23,26,29,32,35,38,41,44]
    return [t1[c] for c in cols],[t2[c] for c in cols]
t1,t2=tracks(current_frame)
print("track1:",t1,"col35=",t1[6])
print("track2:",t2,"col35=",t2[6])
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':25,'col':14}])
print("after UL-red: level_completed:", res.get('level_completed'), "done:", res.get('done'))
t1b,t2b=tracks(current_frame)
print("track1:",t1b,"col35=",t1b[6])
print("track2:",t2b,"col35=",t2b[6])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
